name: City Council
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Monday, April 21, 2014 - 07:00 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Councilmember Waronek
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
Andy Perez, of Union Pacific Railroad - Public Recognition and Appreciation for Donation of $5,000 to the City's Railroad Museum
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a 5 minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Minutes of the Regular City Council meeting held on April 7, 2014. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
Minutes of April 7, 2014
c.
Resolution 2014-15, Approving the Demands and Payroll. RECOMMEND ADOPT RESOLUTION.
2014-04-21 Demands and Reso No. 2014-15
d.
Dial A Taxi, Termination of a Contract with City of Torrance. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
Staff Report 7.d
e.
Resolution 2014-16, Approving Participation in the Los Angeles Urban County Community Development Block Grant Program. RECOMMEND ADOPT RESOLUTION
Staff Report 7.e
f.
Approve a lease of 700 acre feet of unused groundwater pumping rights to Golden State Water Company at $70 an acre foot. The total amount of revenue received would be $49,000. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
Staff Report 7.f
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
8.
AWARD OF BID FOR THE CITY OF LOMITA GYMNASIUM AND COMMUNITY BUILDING UPGRADE PROJECT.
Presented by Special Projects Coordinator Felix
Staff Report 8
9.
DISCUSSION AND INTRODUCTION OF ORDINANCE NO. 766, AMENDING THE APPOINTMENT AUTHORITY OF THE CITY CLERK FROM THE CITY COUNCIL TO THE CITY MANAGER.
Presented by City Manager Rock
Staff Report 9
PUBLIC HEARING:
10.
LANDSCAPE MAINTENANCE DISTRICT NO.1 AND EXTENSION OF MAINTENANCE AGREEMENT WITH TOYO LANDSCAPING COMPANY Discussion and possible approval of the assessment for the annual maintenance, operation, and servicing of the Palos Verdes bicycle path, the boundaries of which are fully described in detail in the Public Works Director's report (Landscape Maintenance District No.1), and Resolution No. 2014-17, approving the engineer's report and confirming the assessment for 2014/15 and approving a one year extension with Toyo Landscaping Company to maintain Landscape Maintenance District No. 1.
Presented by Acting Public Works Director Shahbazi
Staff Report 10
11.
ADJOURNMENT In memory of Alfred William Gamache a long time Lomita resident, WW II and Korean US Navy veteran, and a member of the Lomita Veterans of Foreign War (VFW) who passed on April 7th.
Lomita City Council will adjourn to a Regular Meeting on May 5, 2014 at 7:00 p.m.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
